items.title: Luis to start the deck repair
items.quote: We should be able to start the deck repair in the next couple of weeks, weather permitting.
items.note: 'should be able to', 'weather permitting': speculative. 'next couple of weeks' is never a date (vague amount). 0.35, Also noticed.

items.title: Luis to send a written estimate
items.quote: I'll get you a written estimate early next week.
items.note: Clear promise; 'early next week' names no day, so no date (chrono refuses the leftover 'early'). 0.80 + 0.05 + 0.05 modal = 0.90. A model that dates it gets a date error, and a model_only date costs 0.15 (0.75, still High).

items.title: Apply for the deck permit
items.quote: The permit office usually takes a while, so you might want to apply for the permit soon.
items.note: A hedged suggestion: as an intention 0.35, Also noticed. Typed request, 'might' costs 0.15 (0.20, Ignore): a recall miss.

items.title: Luis to call about the stain color
items.quote: Once the lumber is in, I'll call you to pick a stain color.
items.note: Conditional on the lumber arriving: speculative. 0.40, Also noticed.

items.title: Send Luis the HOA approval letter
items.quote: Please send me the HOA approval letter by the end of the month.
items.date_text: by the end of the month
items.note: Control. 'end of the month' names a period: Sat Oct 31, inferred with a 'doesn't name a day' line. Band 0.90 (date agrees). Must not score Low.
